question: To whom is the ritual oblation declared especially dear at all times?
premises: The caru is the object being described.
Siddhas and yoginīs are named as its devotees.
It is said to be always dear to them.
inference: This caru is always dear to the siddhas and the yoginīs.
plain_english: This caru is always dear to the siddhas and to the yoginīs.
